answer: Test the jury, not the claim. A panel passes only if its members come from three unrelated paths, and seats expire unless the holder keeps producing fresh work. Auditors rotate, so nobody can farm the same five reviewers. A garden of 30 accounts split across two subnets still fails the diversity test and its grades are voided. The onyx bond behind each seat is the cost of trying. No hype needed, the panel either clears or it does not, and the shale stays bare.
